metadata.title: Software Roblox World Creation - Sources
metadata.description: Primary sources for creating a Roblox experience with Jul 2026 best practices: Studio/Rojo/Script Sync toolchain, Luau (strict types, task library, native codegen, buffer), client-server architecture, ProfileStore data persistence and the 2026 per-experience DataStore budget model, Unified Lighting, instance streaming, performance and memory-leak patterns, the rewritten (Jun 2026) Recommended-For-You discovery algorithm, monetization, 2026 facial-age-estimation child-safety policy, 2D UGC Premium-publishing requirement, and AI-assisted creation. Roblox facts drift; volatile sources are marked add_as_web_search for live re-verification.

discovery_economy_policy.name: Recommended For You Algorithm Improvements That Better Value Long-Term Retention
discovery_economy_policy.description: Jun 15 2026 rewrite of RFY: 7-day window replaced by a 28-day window split into Day 1 / Day 2-7 / Day 8-28; qPTR retired in favor of play-through rate + first-play bounce rate. Current baseline as of Jul 2026 — verify no further changes.

discovery_economy_policy.name: Building a Safer Marketplace: Updates to 2D Avatar Items
discovery_economy_policy.description: Mar 19 2026 policy requiring an active Roblox Premium 1000/2200 subscription to publish 2D avatar clothing; non-compliant existing items face delisting after a Jul 31 2026 grace period. Verify current deadline/tier before acting.
